title: Parameter Implementation — Top11 Ringrail Entrypoint
purpose: Implement domain command-inline parameters for Top11 Ringrail Entrypoint

preconditions.milestone: M03 prior gates and existing menu-binding L4 verified
preconditions.technical_environment: Real OpenMatrix9 fork, pinned QymCAD audit checkout, Rust/OCCT toolchain, test fixtures
preconditions.unresolved_owner_policy: Verify owner function signatures and tests before integration

steps: Read OM9_Milestones/M03 - Geometry 3DM/L2-03-08 - 07-febe-matrix-top11/L3-005 - Top11 Ringrail Entrypoint/l3.json#/parameter_contract.interaction and each command_options[].inline record; treat the L3 contract as the single source.
Classify every option as toggle/cycle/choice/value-entry/point-entry/specialized/unsupported, with stage availability and disabled reason; do not invent a shortcut or default.
Implement the shared inline token/span formatter: keyboard initials, typed full names and click targets all call Controller::submit; remove the legacy floating button row for this command.
Resolve type/default/range/unit/current value from the owner snapshot, not by parsing the prompt or display label; keep UNRESOLVED where the owner is not yet known.
Add fixtures for keyboard, click span, stale run/ID, nonempty draft, IME/paste, invalid token, cancel/Esc and Undo; assert owner state and no document mutation.
Run focused tests and record observed evidence; a rendered inline token or a passing metadata test is not a runtime PASS.
role_checklist: Do not duplicate the geometry owner; dispatch through the existing command/feature service.
One prompt/editor/draft only; preserve nonempty drafts, paste, IME, selection and unrelated focus.
Advertise only the recorded unique stage accelerator; fall back to the full option name instead of guessing a conflicting initial.
Do not activate hidden options; keep unsupported options visible and disabled with an explicit reason.
Remove the legacy per-command button row after the inline path is migrated; do not run both paths.
work_plan.expected_positive: Each listed inline option accepts keyboard/click input, updates owner state and produces the documented observable result.
work_plan.expected_negative: Invalid, stale, hidden or unsupported inline input is rejected with a visible reason, draft/focus preserved and no document mutation.
required_technical_decisions: Option type/default/range/unit are resolved from manual and owner code, not inferred from the catalog label.
One shared CommandOptionInterface/formatter serves menu, CMD, inline keyboard and click paths.
Shortcut resolution is full name first, then a unique already-advertised stage accelerator; conflicts do not get a fabricated initial.

acceptance.expected_observable: Every inline option has typed value/activation/availability metadata and keyboard/click routes through Controller::submit.
acceptance.negative_observable: Invalid, stale, hidden or conflicting inline input is refused with a visible reason, draft/focus preserved and no document mutation.
checklist: All inline options have activation/availability/shortcut/value owner or an explicit BLOCKED reason.
Keyboard initial/full name and click span use the same Controller::submit handler.
No legacy floating button row remains for this command after migration.
Evidence contains actual keyboard/click receipts, owner state and observed outputs.
acceptance.pass_rule: EXECUTION_PASS only with actual tests and evidence; planning text is not implementation proof.

implementation_sample_guide:
## Code mẫu / thuật toán mẫu (sketch, không phải bằng chứng)

**Trạng thái:** `author_skeleton_untrusted` — code mẫu để bắt đầu, KHÔNG phải bằng chứng và không được báo cáo là đã triển khai.

**Vai trò được sinh mẫu:** `IMPLEMENT` x1.

### Quy tắc dùng code mẫu

- Mẫu chỉ nêu tên những thứ đã có trong chính bản ghi này (API đề xuất / `implementation_algorithm` / `source_paths`) hoặc thư viện chuẩn Rust — không có symbol bịa.
- `unimplemented!()` là cố ý: mẫu là khung, không chạy được và không chứng minh hành vi nào.
- Code tham chiếu từ QymCAD (revision đã khóa) và từ Matrix9 phải **đọc rồi ADAPT**, không copy nguyên văn; phạm vi license lấy từ M00.
- Oracle dương/âm trong mẫu lấy từ bản ghi; điều kiện PASS vẫn là command receipt exit 0 cộng oracle đo được từ lần chạy thật.
